subject: POC Trial: Ownership, Success Criteria & RACI (HorizonCare)
message_1_subject: POC Trial: Ownership, Success Criteria & RACI (HorizonCare)
message_1_body:
Thanks again for taking the time today - good conversation.

Recap (from our discovery call):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for customer-facing clinical summarization pipeline (latency target <= 350ms p50, cost target ~ $0.003/token equivalent for production).
- Scope for POC: 2-week trial on dev environment, ~50k tokens/day simulated load, integration with your staging API and S3 data access.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Latency: p50 < 350ms, p95 < 800ms for 1k token/response test set.
  2) Throughput: sustain 10 concurrent sessions with <20% degradation vs baseline.
  3) Quality: automated evals show no >5% regression on ROUGE/F1 vs current baseline.
  4) Ops: end-to-end setup in your staging VPC, KV caching configured, and security checklist signed off.

Ask: please confirm (a) the success criteria above, (b) who will own each area below on your side (names + emails), and (c) procurement timeline if we need a purchase order for a short trial license (often required for our Dedicated/Private options).

Proposed RACI (placeholder) - please update:
- App owner (integration, endpoints): R = HorizonCare App Team (please provide name)
- Infra/Networking (VPC, peering, firewall rules): R = HorizonCare Infra / DevOps
- Security/compliance (SOC2, encryption controls): R = HorizonCare Security; A = Redwood Security (evidence and support)
- Procurement/PO: R = HorizonCare Procurement (Miguel?)
- Redwood owners: A = Marissa (deal), R = Dylan (SE, infra integration), C = Evelyn (security review), I = Lauren (CS for onboarding)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm owners for App / Infra / Security / Procurement by EOD Thursday (2026-03-12).
2) Redwood sends POC plan + network checklist (attached) and schedules a 30-45m kickoff for week of 3/15.
3) Security sync if needed (Redwood SOC2 summary attached).

Attachments: poc-plan-horizoncare-2026-03-10.pdf (POC timeline + tests), network-checklist-horizoncare-2026-03-12.xlsx (network and firewall items), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (security artifacts overview).

If that all looks good I'll lock the kickoff on Monday, 3/15 at 10am PT - please flag conflicts.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
message_2_subject: Re: POC Trial: Ownership, Success Criteria & RACI (HorizonCare)
message_2_body:

sana.rahman@horizoncare.com
message_3_subject: Re: POC Trial: Ownership, Success Criteria & RACI (HorizonCare)
message_3_body:
Hi Sana / James - thanks, and helpful to have owners. Quick answers on infra and auth: 

- For staging POC we support both mTLS and IP allowlist. mTLS requires cert exchange; IP allowlist is quicker for short trials if you can provide stable outbound IPs.
- Network checklist (attached) covers ports (443 for API), CIDR ranges for our staging nodes, and S3 access roles.
- I'll be the Redwood technical lead during the POC (contact: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai). I'll own integration tasks and coordinate with your infra.

Proposed timeline:
- 3/12: Finalize owners and send any procurement PO notes.
- 3/15: 30-45m kickoff (walk through POC plan and network checklist).
- 3/16-3/27: Test window (2 weeks) with daily check-ins first 3 days, then async updates.
- 3/30: Wrap & evaluation meeting; deliver final perf/quality report.

I've attached a lightweight POC runbook (poc-plan-horizoncare-2026-03-10.pdf) and the network checklist. If you want mTLS we'll exchange certs before kickoff - Miguel, can you confirm whether IP allowlist or mTLS is preferred?

Thanks,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
message_4_subject: Re: POC Trial: Ownership, Success Criteria & RACI (HorizonCare) - security items
message_4_body:
Hi all - looping in a few security checklist items to make the kickoff smooth. 

Must-haves for POC (we can be flexible on evidence level for trial but need these):
- Network: IP allowlist or mTLS for API access - if IP allowlist, please provide CIDR and any nat gateway IPs the staging environment will use.
- Data handling: confirm PII/data minimization for POC datasets; if full PHI is required we need a signed BA and special handling (please specify).
- Encryption: in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest; for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS.
- Audit: we can provide SOC2 summary and relevant controls (attached). For full review, we'll schedule a follow-up with your compliance folks.

Ownership notes (to make RACI explicit):
- HorizonCare Security: Responsible (R) for security acceptance and confirming dataset scope.
- HorizonCare Infra: Responsible (R) for network config and peering.
- Redwood Security (Evelyn): Consulted (C) and will provide artifacts and remediation guidance.
- Redwood SE (Dylan): Responsible (R) for technical integration.

Please reply with the preferred auth option (mTLS vs IP allowlist) and whether the POC will include PHI - we can adjust the agreement and timeline accordingly.

Evelyn Hart
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

James Porter

james.porter@horizoncare.com
